clips.title: The story
paras: At the Valley of Trials in Durotar, Mai'ah trains young Darkspear trolls in magic. She guides new spellcasters as they begin their path among the Horde.

Young Darkspear trolls come to Mai'ah in the Valley of Trials to learn magic. Orcs favor the elements or the warrior's path, but trolls have a rare gift for arcane study. Candidates bring glyphic inscriptions, and Mai'ah teaches them to shape raw power into controlled incantations. That control matters in Durotar, where danger waits beyond the den.
